# BATCH MODE CROSS-DOMAIN COMPARISON (2026-11-23)
Domains Compared:
1. DOMAIN_EXPANSION_EGO (`SC-IT-DOMAIN-EXPANSION-EGO-001`: 15 core nodes, 225 pairs, 8 modifiers, hub-and-hierarchy topology)
2. POKEMON (`SC-IT-POKEMON-001`: 18 types, 324 pairs, 25 modifier entities, cyclic 16-triangle + 8-zero topology)
3. Reference Bridge A — Path of Exile (5 damage channels, 5 ailments, Chaos Inoculation, ES Recharge, Leech, Soul Eater)
4. Reference Bridge B — Wu Xing (5 phases, 25 pairs, symmetric generation & control rings)

## Cross-Domain Counterplay Matrix (12 Shared Mechanical Primitives)
1. Hard-Zero Restriction Trade (Class 6): Toji 0-CE <-> Pokemon Ghost/Ground/Flying/Levitate <-> PoE Chaos Inoculation <-> Air-gapped networks (Counterplay: orthogonal/inanimate bypass: Malevolent Shrine Dismantle / Stealth Rock / Stuxnet USB).
2. Absorb-Convert / Edge Inversion (Class 13): Dante Royal Guard & Yuta RCT & Sasuke Preta Path <-> Pokemon Water/Volt Absorb, Flash Fire, Earth Eater, Well-Baked Body, Grass<-Water <-> PoE Leech & Damage-Taken-As <-> Wu Xing Generation Feed (Counterplay: orthogonal non-metabolized channel or Mold Breaker).
3. Operative Domain Arena & Clash (Class 15): JJK Closed/Open/Simple Domains <-> Pokemon 4 Weathers & 4 Terrains (Weather Wars) <-> AI In-Distribution Models & Firewalls (Counterplay: exterior shatter / OOD attack / overwriting setter).
4. Cumulative Stacking Toxin (Class 11): Pokemon Toxic N/16 <-> PoE Poison Stacks <-> Heavy-metal bioaccumulation & server memory leaks (Counterplay: switch-out/restart reset or Steel 0x / CI immunity).
5. Rate Suppression (Class 10): Unlimited Void paralysis <-> Pokemon Freeze/Paralysis/Sleep/Trick Room <-> PoE Chill/Freeze <-> API throttling (Counterplay: channel immunity, priority, or status cleanse).
6. Self-Sustaining Chain Reaction (Class 2): Itachi Amaterasu <-> Pokemon Fire/Burn <-> PoE Ignite <-> Wildfire/viral spread (Counterplay: break fuel/oxidizer/heat triangle).
7. Cyclic Control Equilibrium (Class 14): Wu Xing 5-ring <-> Pokemon 5 strict RPS triangles (Fire-Grass-Water, Fire-Steel-Rock, Grass-Ground-Poison, Dark-Psychic-Fighting, Fighting-Rock-Flying) <-> Ecological trophic cascades (Counterplay: regulator removal triggers runaway target explosion).
8. Multiplicative Common-Mode Failure (Class 19): Pokemon Dual-Typing 4x weakness (Bug/Steel vs Fire) <-> Redundant cloud/aerospace shared dependency failure (Counterplay: diversify orthogonal defense layers; avoid correlated weaknesses).
9. Governor-Removal Overdrive + Load-Coupled Leak (Classes 18+12): Guts Berserker Armor <-> PoE Bleed & Blood Rage <-> Unthrottled silicon overclock & physiological adrenaline tearing (Counterplay: external anchor / circuit breaker).
10. Coordinate-Manifold Cut (Class 17): Yami Dimension Slash vs Gojo Infinity <-> Side-channel hardware attacks (Spectre/DPA) vs cryptographic ciphers (Counterplay: harden hosting substrate, not just key-space distance).
11. Multiplicative Cross-Link Compounding (Class 16): Yuta Copy + Meta-Compiler Soul Eater <-> PoE Soul Eater <-> Knowledge-graph transfer learning (Counterplay/Risk: O(N^2) hubness drift requiring Gate 0 pruning).
12. FAILED Prediction Structural Break (PRED-BATCH-005): Predicted Electric 2x vs Steel across real physics + PoE Lightning conductivity -> FAILS in Pokemon (actual=1x neutral; Steel->Electric is 0.5x BALANCE-ONLY), proving strict non-identity and validating residual auditing.

claims.text: Across DOMAIN_EXPANSION_EGO (15 nodes, 225 pairs), POKEMON (18 types, 324 pairs), PoE, and Wu Xing, 19 invariant classes (14 seed + 5 new) and 7 multi-class compositions govern every non-balance-only mechanical interaction.

Hard-Zero Inversion Law (PRED-BATCH-001): Every hard-zero immunity (Toji 0-CE, Gojo Infinity, PoE Chaos Inoculation, Pokemon 8 0x edges, air-gapped networks) transfers the exact counterplay failure mode—lethal vulnerability to an orthogonal un-modeled channel.

Arena-Field Overwrite Law (PRED-BATCH-002): Operative externalized domains (JJK Domains, Pokemon Weather/Terrain, AI deployment contexts) enforce axiomatic rules inside scope and resolve clashes via refinement dominance or latest field overwrite.

Edge-Inversion Counterplay Law (PRED-BATCH-003): Absorb-Convert defenses (Pokemon 11 abilities, Dante Royal Guard, Yuta RCT, PoE Leech, adversarial ML training) turn standard pressure into defender gain, strictly forcing orthogonal channel switching.

Topological Divergence Finding: DOMAIN_EXPANSION_EGO is hub-and-hierarchy dominated (Meta_Compiler deg=24, Gojo deg=16, 0 strict BEATS 3-cycles, 7 broad counterplay 3-cycles), whereas POKEMON is cyclically balanced (16 3-cycles, 5 strict RPS triangles, 8 hard zeros, Steel defensive hub deg=21) and embeds Wu Xing's 5-phase rings directly.

Explicit Falsification Verification (PRED-BATCH-005 FAILED): Predicting Electric 2x vs Steel in Pokemon from real electromagnetic conductivity fails (actual=1x neutral; Steel->Electric is 0.5x BALANCE-ONLY), demonstrating that the compiler detects and logs structural breaks honestly as residual_mismatches.
